SSC Compass · Aurora Software Labs

Privacy Policy

How SSC Compass handles your study records, account and device data.

Updated 7 November 2026

Who runs SSC Compass

SSC Compass is a Maharashtra SSC study planner published by Aurora Software Labs. This policy covers the app and its optional cloud sync.

Using the app without an account

Your plan stays in this browser or installed web app. This includes lesson progress, strengths, marks and mistake notes, tasks, focus sessions, and settings. The browser also caches app files so the planner can open offline. The hosted app receives ordinary web requests when you load it online.

Accounts and cloud sync

Registration asks for a student name, school, board, email address and password. Firebase Authentication handles sign-in and password resets. The app sends your password directly to Firebase and does not store it in your study plan or browser storage. The app stores sign-in tokens in your browser to keep you signed in. When signed in, your profile and study plan sync to Google Cloud Firestore so you can use the same account on another device. The default Firestore database is in Mumbai, India. If you connect a different Firebase project in Settings, that project handles your sign-in and synced records.

How we use the information

The app uses your records to save your plan, calculate progress and estimates, and schedule study reminders. SSC Compass does not include advertising trackers or analytics. Firebase provides hosting, authentication and cloud storage. Read Firebase’s privacy and security information.

Notifications, exports and shared devices

Browser reminders use your device’s notification permission, which you can change in browser or system settings. When you export a backup or import a calendar file into another service, that copy is handled by you and any service you share it with. Signing out clears the active session. Saved browser copies can remain on the device until you clear this site’s data.

Access, correction and deletion

You can update your profile and study records in the app and export your plan from Settings. To remove device copies, clear this site’s browser data. Clearing browser data or signing out does not delete your cloud plan. To request access, correction or deletion of your hosted account and synced plan, email Aurora Software Labs support. If you connected your own Firebase project, contact its administrator. Support receives the information you include in your message. Never send your password.

Student privacy

If you are a minor, ask a parent or guardian before creating an account or submitting personal information. A parent or guardian can contact support about a student’s account or data.
